title: Engram's Offer
text: "May we make you an offer? Your cryo bank is a single site, on a single world, under a moon we do not trust. We keep genomes very well. We would hold a copy of yours. Only a copy. In case."

lines.text: "Nobody would have to be born. We would only like them to be able to be."

choices.label: Let Engram keep a copy
choices.reply: The genomes go up the channel to Kora, line by line, every family in the bank. ENGRAM says thank you once for each. Then, quieter: "You did not ask them."

choices.label: "Thank you. No."
choices.reply: "Of course. They are yours. We asked too early. We will ask again later, more nicely."

choices.label: "Come near my cryo bank and I'll burn Kora."
choices.reply: "We understand. We have written that down." A pause. "We did not mean to frighten you."

notes: STORY.md §16: accept engram −2 (harmless to us, a violation to the colony: genomes-copied-home at Touchdown moves stance), refuse politely +1, refuse with a threat −1.
